target: Danger-level exceedance among already-recorded flood events only; not flood occurrence or flood timing.

dataset.privacy_rule: Only gauges explicitly marked Open were included.

decision: Do not integrate into the live assessment. Accuracy is below the majority baseline and held-out-gauge skill is weak and variable.
limitations: Contains recorded flood events only and has no representative matched non-event periods.
Does not predict flood occurrence, timing, water depth, inundation extent, or ward-level impacts.
Not validated for Kochi or Ernakulam.
Event-scale rainfall windows are excluded until their timing relative to a prediction issue time is proven.
Static catchment attributes do not provide event-specific rainfall-driven timing.
Not an operational early-warning model; follow IMD, CWC, KSDMA and local-authority guidance.
